goal: Stop the HTTP server from reading socket data while a request on that connection is being processed
Prevent prematurely reopening the TCP window and defeating backpressure
Fix intermittent failures in HTTP functional tests
reviewability: CI is failing so verify whether the failure is caused by this PR before deep review
agreement: Approach approval to enforce strictly serial request processing without pipelining (winterrdog)
Unaddressed objection: adds a ~50ms latency floor on keep-alive RPC requests, no author reply (151henry151)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it fixes backpressure detection and prevents intermittent HTTP test failures
Impact is minor because the bug buffers at most 65kB and poses no critical out-of-memory risk
